name: Click Spark
description: Wrapper that bursts canvas sparks from the pointer position on every click inside it, with selectable spark shape, colors, gravity, spread, glow and an optional ring.
contents: Full-size relative wrapper div rendering its children
Overlay layer that holds a short-lived canvas per click burst
Imperative spark(x, y) method exposed through ref
behavior: Left mouse press spawns a burst of sparks at the cursor; touch, pen and keyboard clicks spawn one on click
Sparks fly outward with the chosen easing, fade out, and can fall with gravity
Colors from an array are cycled across the sparks of a burst
Keeps at most 32 bursts alive, oldest are removed first
Under prefers-reduced-motion, sparks show a short static fade instead of travelling
editableByProps: Spark shape, color or color list, size, width, radius, count and duration
Easing, randomness, gravity, spread angle and direction
Glow, expanding ring, front or back layer, disabling the effect
Wrapper className and style, and the children it wraps

needsCodeEdit.change: Trigger on touch pointerdown as well as mouse
Raise or lower the number of simultaneous bursts

fixed: Wrapper is always relative, isolated and h-full w-full, so the parent needs a defined height
Only left mouse button triggers on press; other pointer types trigger on click
Sparks are clipped to the viewport per burst canvas, device pixel ratio capped at 2
Values are clamped: count 1 to 64, duration at least 60, width at least 0.5, spread 0 to 360, glow and randomness 0 to 1
Unknown shape or easing falls back to line or ease-out
Burst settings are captured at click time, so prop changes affect only new bursts
Respects prefers-reduced-motion, read once on mount
Unknown colors that the canvas cannot parse render as black for the streak gradient

options.look: Short radiating strokes with rounded caps that shrink as they travel
options.useWhen: Classic click feedback on buttons or a hero where a clean burst is wanted

options.look: Comet-like tapered trails with a fading tail and round head
options.useWhen: Fast, energetic call-to-action areas or gaming pages

options.look: Small round particles that shrink while flying out
options.useWhen: Soft playful confetti-like feedback on friendly or kids oriented pages

options.look: Four-point twinkling stars that spin and pulse
options.useWhen: Magical or celebratory moments such as sign-up success or premium highlights
